subject: Security posture & next steps — Private VPC / SOC 2 / VSQ
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-08-15T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Security posture & next steps — Private VPC / SOC 2 / VSQ

Thanks again for the call today, Samantha — good to meet you and the Acme security team. Quick recap and the next steps we discussed:

- Use case summary: Low-latency customer-facing features that process PII; primary requirement is network isolation and strict access controls.
- Redwood delivery options discussed: Hosted API (short-term), Dedicated GPU pools (reserved), Private VPC / on-prem (long-term). You indicated Private VPC + customer-managed networking is the preferred path.
- Compliance questions:
  - SOC 2 Type II: you asked for attestation and control set mapping (we have our latest Type II report and control narrative).
  - GDPR & HIPAA: our platform supports data residency, access controls, and optional BAA.
  - Vendor security questionnaire (VSQ): you mentioned Acme uses an internal VSQ (spreadsheet) to onboard infra vendors.
- Network/deployment: you wanted an initial deployment diagram showing VPC peering, NAT/GW placement, and recommended isolation patterns (we agreed to provide a diagram).

Immediate next steps (owners + ETA):
1) Marcus / Redwood: Share deployment diagram + SOC 2 attestation PDF by EOD tomorrow (I will attach).
2) Monica / Redwood: Own the VSQ completion — will coordinate with your security contact and aim to return the VSQ within 5 business days.
3) Samantha / Acme: Send the VSQ file and any specific evidence requests or sections you prioritize (network, encryption, logging).
4) Schedule a technical follow-up (30–45 min) to walk the diagram and answer any control-specific questions — proposed times below.

Proposed times for follow-up: Thu 8/17 10:00–10:45 PT or Fri 8/18 13:00–13:45 PT. Let me know what works.

Attachments I will send in the thread: redwood-deployment-diagram.png (initial sketch), redwood-soc2-attestation.pdf (latest report stub). Monica will follow up on the VSQ.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this forward.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

---
(Read below for quoted reply from Acme security if any)

From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: security@acme.com
Date: 2028-08-15T16:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Security posture & next steps — Private VPC / SOC 2 / VSQ

Thanks Marcus — appreciate the clear recap. A few notes from the Acme security side:

- VSQ: attaching our standard VSQ (acme-vsq.xlsx). We typically prioritize network architecture, encryption at rest/in transit, key management, logging/monitoring, and access control. Please have Monica focus on the network and logging sections first.
- SOC 2: we require a current SOC 2 Type II report and control matrix. If you can provide the attestation PDF and a short mapping to our questionnaire controls, that would speed things up.
- Air-gapped / on-prem: we are evaluating an air-gapped option for production-only environments. Please call out whether Redwood supports air-gapped deployments or if Private VPC with strict egress rules is the recommended approach.
- Evidence: for any controls you mark as implemented, we will ask for evidence (screenshots, config snippets, or third-party attestations).

Proposed follow-up: Thu 8/17 10:00 PT works for our team. I'll loop procurement (procurement@acme.com) if needed after we validate the controls.

Thanks,
Samantha Lee
Security Program Manager
Acme Corp
samantha.lee@acme.com

Attachment: acme-vsq.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-08-15T19:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Security posture & next steps — Private VPC / SOC 2 / VSQ

Great — thanks for the VSQ, Samantha. Per our commitments, attaching the artifacts we discussed and a couple quick clarifications: 

Attachments included: 
- redwood-deployment-diagram.png (initial Private VPC deployment sketch: customer VPC, peering with Redwood managed subnet for inference workers, optional transit gateway for on-prem connectivity).
- redwood-soc2-attestation.pdf (latest SOC 2 Type II coverage, period: 2028-01-01 to 2028-06-30).

Clarifications:
- Air-gapped: Redwood supports an on-prem, air-gapped install for customers who require it. That option is a packaged Private deployment; it requires onsite provisioning and a short professional services engagement. For most customers who want cloud-hosted isolation, Private VPC with strict egress controls + customer-managed KMS is our recommended pattern.
- Evidence: Monica will lead the VSQ responses and can provide screenshots, CloudTrail/flow logs examples, and configs for KMS and network ACLs.
- Timeline: Monica expects to return a filled VSQ and supporting evidence within 3–5 business days after clarifying a couple of network questions with you.

Monica — can you take point on the VSQ? I gave Samantha permission to re-share any control-specific sample artifacts.

Next meeting confirmed: Thu 2028-08-17 10:00–10:45 PT — invite to follow.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-deployment-diagram.png, redwood-soc2-attestation.pdf

From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@acme.com, security@acme.com
Date: 2028-08-16T09:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Security posture & next steps — Private VPC / SOC 2 / VSQ

Thanks Marcus — received the artifacts. Procurement looped in to start the commercial/PO conversation in parallel. A couple small asks before the meeting: 

- Monica: can you confirm whether the deployment diagram shows any egress to public endpoints (we'd prefer zero egress except for controlled updates). If yes, can you mark what traffic is required and why?
- Please include a short note on key management: do you support customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM)? Is HSM integration available for the Private/on-prem package?

We'll review the VSQ sections overnight and flag any clarifying questions. Looking forward to Thu.

Best,
Samantha

(Procurement cc'd)
